run_agreement.definition: Pairwise agreement between parsed prediction objects for the same strategy and record across different runs. API and parse failures are excluded from agreement comparisons and remain counted in reliability rates.

metric_definitions.macro_average: Unweighted mean across every allowed class in the schema.
metric_definitions.invalid_classification_prediction: Missing or out-of-schema predicted classification values are counted as invalid predictions and as false negatives for the gold class.
metric_definitions.extraction_null_semantics: Null means not extracted/unknown; false is a populated boolean value. Wrong non-null extractions count as both a false positive and a false negative.
metric_definitions.record_exact_match: All nine predicted fields must exactly equal the gold object.
metric_definitions.run_agreement: Pairwise agreement between parsed predictions for the same strategy and record across runs.
